about_the_game:
Madeline didn’t come here to play hero, she came to steal. Deep inside the long-abandoned plant lies a legendary prize, sealed away since the world fell apart. But something else was left behind… things that shouldn’t move, things stitched from childhood comfort and soaked in nightmare.

Now, every step through the rusted corridors echoes with laughter, soft, hollow, and wrong.

Survive the Factory

  • Battle through toxic chambers, flooded waste pits, and decaying machinery in a grounded, old-school FPS with fast combat and tight level design.

  • No jumping. No lifts. Every path, drop, and detour is hand-crafted for pure, classic movement and flow.

Face the Forgotten Toys

  • Encounter disturbing soft toys brought to life and filled with malice.

  • Each encounter blends nostalgia with horror, turning innocence into terror.

Explore & Uncover

  • Discover hidden rooms, keys, and shortcuts buried beneath industrial ruin.

  • Piece together the story of what twisted this factory into a graveyard of memories.

You came for the prize.
Now you’re fighting to leave with your life.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of gore and violence, including dismemberment of enemies and visible red blood splatter during combat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 260X (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Play as Madeline, who broke into an abandoned plant chasing a legendary prize buried in rusted halls. But something else was waiting, grotesque toys that move and kill on sight. Navigate toxic corridors and decaying machinery. No jumping. No lifts. Just pure, grounded old-school carnage.
